identity_rules.experiment_id: Stable content-addressed or UUID-like ID recorded before execution; it must include or reference the frozen config/dataset identity.
identity_rules.output_namespace: outputs/stage3_experiments/<experiment_id>/ for future experiments; H1 qualification outputs use outputs/stage3_h1_* and are separate.
identity_rules.artifact_immutability: After finalization, artifacts are read-only by policy; revisions receive a new experiment_id or contract version.
identity_rules.timestamps: UTC ISO-8601 with timezone; monotonic timers are separately recorded for phase timing

h1_identity.purpose: contract freeze and offline capability qualification

provenance: attached Stage 3 H1 request: immutable experiment identity/provenance
